Coronary angiography revealed no evidence of relevant coronary artery disease
decisive_items: Endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling
moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling
response.rationale: R1 is anchored by the definitive endomyocardial biopsy showing chronically active myocarditis, whereas R5 rests only on the echocardiographic takotsubo-like pattern and was a pre-biopsy suspicion. R2 and R4 are temporal/history associations without causal raw spans. C1 is an append-only completion of R1 and is discounted as a correlated restatement.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R1 using the same biopsy span; no independent raw evidence.
Recent surgery is temporally associated but does not explain biopsy-proven myocarditis.
Treated hypertension is chronic and non-specific; coronary angiography excluded ischaemic cause.
